full_page.content:
Page 290 Cont.
July 20 Fr. Lynch ..... Chaplin. ..
25 Kenneth Abrahams - 6 ~ Jewish - very seriously hurt - dragged foot by frightened horse - little hope of recovery. Enrolled % phone at 9:18 a.m. Today
Mr. Ryan - elderly - Lost very good position - Sister of Cincinnati la- ments asks for prayers.
26 Thanks - James Reutkowski - 12 - here Dec. 18 last year - i.e. repre- sented by parents - half - broken hearted; had been 16 months on back with Rhumatic fever, was Enrolled that day - here To-day quite OK.
28 Mrs. Florence - 25 - in Kiefer's Hos. - T.B. a few yrs ago; got well enough to go back to work. Now back and in threatening condition.
Thomas Frank - 14 - tuomer on brain removed in June 1939 - i.e. partly removed. Drs. gave no hope; came to curb-stone, was Enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n August 7. Drs. gave him 6 mo. He is back To-day decided- ly better - Can talk again. (See Aug. 14, 40.)
Page 291 July 28 Earl Edward Lines - Born last Friday - Parents having prayed for a fam- ily for 17 yrs. - having adopted a little one five years "ago". ....
baby not well ...
29 Thanks - Leonard Goulden - 21 - over two years hopelessly nervous. Drs. said "Scientifically nothing can be done. Enrolled and way prayed for ... is OK. now.
1941, August
Aug. 3 Baby John Parpart 22 yrs. fell against table-leg last Thanksgiving Day - began to show signs of weakness shortly after - was taken to hospital - has lost his speech and condition gives little hope - only child.
3 Jos. Lantry - 48 - heart condition, very weak - figuering on drastic treatment to-morrow. Enrolled Tonight 2.00
Henry E. Bellarney - 64 - a long time away from the sacraments and from Church.
Cath. Schubert - 92 - fell April Ist and broke leg. ....
